units: <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 5:8">Deut. R. s. 5</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Jeremiah 2:24">Jer. II, 24</cite>) <he>כשם שהפ׳ גדל וכ׳</he> (some ed. <he>שהעָרֹד</he>) as the wild ass is raised in the desert and is without fear of man, so did I intend that no fear of governments should rest upon you; (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 266:6">Yalk. Jer. 266</cite> <cite ref="P01320"><he>עָרוֹד</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 45:9">Gen. R. s. 45</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 16:12">Gen. XVI, 12</cite>) <he>פ׳ אדם וודאי וכ׳</he> ‘a savage among men’ in its literal sense, for all other plunder goods, but he (Edom-Rome) captures souls.
